text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"orders 3 magazines"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"send 12 issues a year"},{"id":"q3","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1 magazine that sends 6 issues a year"},{"id":"q4","value":6,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"6 issues a year"},{"id":"q5","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"4 times the amount"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply the 3 magazines by 12 issues each to find issues from that group"},{"op":"mul","args":["q5","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply 4 by the 6-issue magazine yearly issues to find how many issues the last magazine sends per year"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"add the issues from the 6-issue magazine itself to the running total"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"add the last magazine's issues to the running total for the overall yearly issue count"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total issues Susan receives across all her magazines each year"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"states she has 1 magazine of the 6-issue kind; multiplying by 1 doesn't change that magazine's issue count, so it isn't needed as a separate factor"}]}
